data.title: Maysan
data.about:
Maysan at Reem Island by Modon Properties is an exceptional freehold residential project redefining luxury living in Abu Dhabi. Offering 3 and 4-bedroom maisonettes and townhouses, Maysan is set across over 600,000 square meters. The first phase features two unique districts, Mayar and Thoraya, introducing Abu Dhabi's first stacked maisonettes and elegant townhouses.

Maysan's residences blend resort-style comfort with community-focused living. The four-story maisonettes and contemporary townhouses cater to families, professionals, and investors seeking sophistication and recreation. Maysan luxury residences at Reem Island offer a new lifestyle standard in the heart of Abu Dhabi.

With extensive amenities like a clubhouse, linear park, pools, playgrounds, gym, and pet park, Maysan at Reem Island ensures a vibrant, engaging community. Explore Maysan by Modon Properties for sale, offering exclusive properties in Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi. This is your chance to experience premium living in a one-of-a-kind development.

characteristics_module.title: Experience the Perfect Balance of Nature and Urban Convenience!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Maysan at Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, offers freehold ownership, making it an ideal investment in a prime location. 
  • Maysan by Modon Properties for Sale provides exclusive 3 & 4-bedroom maisonettes and townhouses, perfect for families and professionals. 
  • The development in the Mayar and Thoraya districts introduces Abu Dhabi's first stacked maisonettes, blending luxury and community living. 
  • Maysan Luxury Residences Abu Dhabi combines resort-style amenities with contemporary design for an unparalleled lifestyle experience. 
  • Properties for Sale in Al Reem Island Abu Dhabi are near top schools, universities, and healthcare facilities, ensuring residents' convenience. 
  • Surrounded by natural beauty, Maysan maisonettes and townhouses offer an eco-friendly, modern living experience within a dynamic urban setting.

location_tile.title: Maysan at Reem Island: Luxury Island Living with Easy City Access and Nearby Attractions.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Maysan at Reem Island offers island living with easy access to Abu Dhabi's vibrant center via Sheikh Zayed Bin Sultan Road. Close to cultural spots like Saadiyat Island and Yas Island, residents enjoy a blend of city life and nature. Surrounded by schools, clinics, and universities like Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi, Maysan by Modon Properties for sale is perfect for families. Properties for sale in Al Reem Island Abu Dhabi also offer rental solid income potential.

  • 5 Minutes to Sorbonne University
  • 10 Minutes to Cleveland Clinic
  • 10 Minutes to Galleria Mall
  • 20 Minutes to Louvre Abu Dhabi
  • 30 Minutes to Zayed International Airport
  • 35 Minutes to Yas Marina Circuit
